onEnter.text: Hello, {partner}! Say bye when you're done.

script.text: Hello, {partner}! Potions, or a recipe, or bottles you're done with?

then.text: Drink one and you glow for an hour. Fourteen shards apiece — how many?

traded.text: Drink them somewhere dark. Anything else?

cancel.text: Suit yourself. Anything else?

then.text: Two shards for every empty bottle. How many have you got?

traded.text: Ta. Anything else?

cancel.text: Keep them, then. Anything else?

then.text: Ten arcane crystals, crushed fine, stirred into a solution I won't name.
The glow is the crystals remembering the light.
Mind the dark, {partner}.

script.text: Mind the sparks, {partner}. Everything on that rack I made myself.

then.text: Blades. Twenty for the plain one, fifty for a knight's, ninety-five for the tempered.
Iron Sword. Straight, quick, asks Blade 6 of you.

traded.text: Keep the edge off the stone. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Knight's Sword. Truer than the iron and slower with it — Blade 20.

traded.text: That one has a name where it came from. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Folded and quenched twice. Blade 34, and worth every point of it.

traded.text: Best blade on the rack, and you know it. Anything else?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Suit yourself. What else?
Axes, then. They land wilder than a blade and they land harder.
A woodsman's axe. Blade 8, and it swings like a chore.

traded.text: Mind your shins. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Broad Axe — a hand's width of edge. Blade 20 and Toughness 8 to hold it up.

traded.text: Heavy at the head, that's the point of it. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Two bits, two hands. Blade 34 and Toughness 16, and nothing stands after it.

traded.text: You'll need both hands and both feet. Anything else?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Fair enough. What else?
Blunt work. Nothing clever about it, and it never turns on the bone.
My own pattern. Blunt 5, and it does the same thing every time.

traded.text: It'll not surprise you. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Flanged head, iron through. Blunt 18.

traded.text: That'll dent a helm. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Both hands. Blunt 32 and Toughness 16 — it's more weight than weapon.

traded.text: Swing it once and mean it. Anything else?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Right you are. What else?
I string them, I don't shoot them. Reach is what you're paying for.
Six cells and a prayer. Ranged 5.

traded.text: Buy the arrows off somebody else. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Eight cells, and it goes where you point it. Ranged 18.

traded.text: That's a bow you can eat off. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Ten cells, and a heavier arrow at the end of them. Ranged 32.

traded.text: Give yourself room. Anything else?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: As you like. What else?
Shields. A shield is held, so it costs you a hand and pays you back on every blow.
A buckler. One point of defence and it weighs nothing.

traded.text: Small, but it's there. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Boards and a rim. Two points, off every blow that lands.

traded.text: It'll split before you do. Anything else on the rack?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Three points. Carry one in each hand if you like — they add.

traded.text: Now let them come. Anything else?

cancel.text: It'll keep. Anything else on the rack?

then.text: Please yourself. What else?

options.label: What are shards worth to you?

then.text: Twenty a rung, and three rungs to every rack. Crystals come out of the caves.
Bring me shards, I'll bring you something that outlives you.
Come back when you've something to spend, {partner}.

script.text: Cloth, leather or plate, {partner}? I stitch all three and I sell all three.

then.text: Body first — it is the piece that is hit. Every point comes off every blow that lands.
Cloth Tunic. One point, and it is better than a shirt.

traded.text: It'll keep the wind off, at least. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Warded Robe. One point, and six against anything arcane.

traded.text: Let them throw fire at you. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Padded Gambeson. Two points, and four more against blunt.

traded.text: A club will not find much in that. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Leather Jerkin. Two points, and two each against blade and arrow.

traded.text: Turns a point better than it turns a hammer. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Tunic of Flames. Two points, and it makes you a fire creature on the wheel.

traded.text: Careful what you stand next to. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Mantle of Brambles. Two points, and it makes you nature on the wheel.

traded.text: Green suits you. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Chain Mail. Three points, and four more against a blade.

traded.text: Rings turn an edge. They do nothing for a maul. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Steel Plate. Five points, three each against blade and arrow. The best I have.

traded.text: Now let them try. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Right. What else?
Heads. Cheap next to what is under them.
Leather Cap. One point.

traded.text: Better than your hair. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Iron Helm. Two points, and two more against blunt.

traded.text: That is what a helm is for. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Knight's Helm. Three points, and three more against a blade.

traded.text: You'll see less and live longer. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: As you like. What else?
Boots. Nobody thinks about boots until something lands on them.
Worn Boots. One point, and somebody else wore them first.

traded.text: They'll do. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Hobnailed Boots. One point, and three against blunt.

traded.text: Nailed through. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Steel Sabatons. Two points, and two against a blade.

traded.text: Heavy, and worth it. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Fair enough. What else?
Charms. None of them is armour and every one of them is defence — read the numbers.
Copper Ring. One flat point, against anything at all.

traded.text: Small and honest. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Bone Charm. Four against a fist or a jaw, and nothing else.

traded.text: Wolves hate it. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Jade Amulet. Five against the arcane.

traded.text: Against a spell, nothing better this side of the robe. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Amulet of Tides. No armour at all — it makes you water on the wheel.

traded.text: Mind who you fight now. What else?

cancel.text: On the rail it stays. Anything else?

then.text: Suit yourself. What else?
None of them. Armour is not a ladder — every point is taken off every blow, and a resistance only answers the thing it names.
So the plate is not simply better than the robe. Ask what is hitting you.
Come back before something bites you, {partner}, not after.
